question: What tradeoff does Jason Fried recommend when introducing Shape Up at a company: adopting it wholesale or changing how teams work incrementally?
expected_points: Adopt useful parts of Shape Up rather than the entire method.

evidence_quote: Take whatever works. You don't have to go wholesale on any of these things.

answer.summary: Jason Fried recommends adopting Shape Up selectively and incrementally, rather than rolling it out wholesale or making a rapid 180-degree change.

sections.heading: Start with what fits
sections.content: Fried says teams—often small groups inside larger companies—can experiment with Shape Up locally; it may spread, but it does not have to. Adopt whichever parts help: for example, just the six-week cycle or the idea of appetites instead of estimates. He cautions that trying to make a rapid, fundamental change can fail because organizations have momentum and cannot turn on a dime.
